scenes.text: A common denominator names equal-sized parts. Multiply numerator and denominator together by the same scale.
Complete: 1/4 equals ?/20. The answer is 5. Multiply numerator and denominator by 5: 5/20.
A recipe fraction at a school fair is 1/6. What is an equivalent fraction with denominator 18? Pause the video and think.
A recipe fraction at a school fair is 1/6. What is an equivalent fraction with denominator 18? The answer is 3. Multiply numerator and denominator by 3: 3/18.
